Under the theme ‘One Group, One Way Forward’, management used Tuesday’s annual general meeting to outline a strategy focused on growing digital revenues, improving cash collections, maximising content value, and eliminating operational duplication.

South Asia - bottom line: Indian Air Force’s Rafale fleet down to 32, aviation publication says, backing Pakistan’s claim of downing four jets.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 16 hours ago: Indian Air Force’s Rafale fleet down to 32, aviation publication says, backing Pakistan’s claim of downing four jets.
The Indian Air Force (IAF) has 32 French-made Rafale fighter jets in service, down from 36 before the May 2025 conflict with Pakistan, according to estimates published by British aviation magazine Flight International. The figures lend credence to Islamabad’s claim that it shot down several Indian Rafale jets during the conflict. In its annual directory of air forces around the world, Flight International listed 32 Rafales in the IAF’s active inventory. Screengrab from Flight International’s November directory on World Air Forces shows IAF’s fleet.
- Dawn (Pakistan), The Hindu - International, 8 hours ago: Trump's Board of Peace faults Israel and Hamas for failure to end Gaza war.
The body overseeing US President Donald Trump’s plan to end the Gaza war accused both Israel and Hamas of failing to meet their commitments to end hostilities, leaving the population of Gaza in dire conditions and the ceasefire in danger of collapse. The 12-page Board of Peace report, seen by Reuters, is the body’s second to the United Nations Security Council since the US-backed ceasefire came into effect 13 months ago. It offers a sobering assessment of progress made since then.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 12 hours ago: Untenable stalemate.
NEARLY nine months into a conflict of choice that has rattled economies from Europe to Asia, there seem to be few agreeable options for the US where ending the Iran war is concerned. No one — perhaps apart from Israel and some hawks in Washington — wants an escalation, while coming to an agreement on Iran’s terms would result in considerable embarrassment for Donald Trump. However, Pakistan, which has played a crucial mediatory role in the conflict, and other regional states still have expectations that a negotiated settlement can be reached.
